summary_ja: この告示は令和六年三月三十一日から適用する。第二条の二第四項各号等の適用は一年間なお従前の例によることができる。
summary_en: Applies from March 31, 2024; Article 2-2, paragraph (4) and Article 47, paragraph (3), item (i) may be applied under the old rules for one year.
paragraphs: This Public Notice applies from March 31, 2024.

With respect to the application of Article 2-2, paragraph (4), each item, and Article 47, paragraph (3), item (i) of the Public Notice Establishing Standards for Determining Whether the Capital Adequacy of an Ultimate Designated Parent Company and Its Subsidiaries, etc. Is Appropriate in Light of Assets, etc. Held by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company and Its Subsidiaries, etc, as amended by this Public Notice, for the period until the day on which one year has elapsed from the date of application of this Public Notice, the provisions then in force may continue to be followed.

sections_en.s26: Supplementary Provisions (FSA Public Notice No. 116 of December 27, 2023)
